description: Soy una niña curiosa, creativa y apasionada por la ciencia, la tecnología y la astronomía. Tengo autismo, dislexia, epilepsia, altas capacidades e hipotonía muscular. Me encanta aprender, investigar, crear proyectos y compartir mis conocimientos. Creo en la inclusión y en que nuestras diferencias no son límites, sino oportunidades para encontrar nuevas formas de hacer las cosas y transformar el mundo.
summary:
International Project for Cosmic Archaeology (IPCA) is an interactive web platform that transforms the abandoned equipment and material traces left by human space exploration into engaging stories, mysteries, and learning experiences.
Inspired by NASA missions to the Moon and Mars, IPCA invites people to explore space artifacts, examine evidence, follow clues, and solve challenges to discover the stories behind these objects. Users can choose different exploration roles and engage with experiences designed for different ages, interests, and levels of scientific knowledge.
We chose a web-based experience to make exploration accessible through a browser, without requiring an app download. Our concept combines space science, storytelling, gamification, and interactive investigation to make space exploration more engaging.
IPCA also proposes a sustainable model based on optional digital tools and hints, science-related product links, relevant advertising, and educational partnerships, while keeping essential educational content free.
Our goal is to make the history of human exploration beyond Earth accessible, engaging, and inspiring.
details: IPCA (International Project for Cosmic Archaeology) is a proposed interactive web platform inspired by NASA's challenge about equipment and material traces left behind by space missions on the Moon and Mars. The experience is designed as a journey of discovery. Users can choose an exploration role, select a destination such as the Moon or Mars, and investigate mission-related objects through stories, evidence, clues, and interactive challenges. The concept offers different ways to explore, from playful discovery to deeper scientific investigation, allowing people with different ages, interests, and levels of knowledge to participate. Instead of requiring users to download an application, IPCA is designed to be accessed through a web browser, reducing barriers to entry. Its purpose is to make space science and the history of exploration more engaging and accessible. The project combines scientific storytelling, gamification, visual interface design, and a proposed sustainable business model. Optional hints and digital tools, science-related product links, relevant advertising, and educational partnerships could help support the platform while keeping essential educational content free. For this project, our team developed the concept, user journey, visual interface mockups, and presentation using digital design and AI-assisted creative tools, including Gemini, ChatGPT, and Canva. The current deliverable is a visual prototype and project concept, not a fully programmed platform. IPCA's creative approach is to treat the objects left by space missions not simply as equipment, but as clues to stories about human exploration. Every discovery becomes an opportunity to learn about science, history, and our presence beyond Earth.
